name: Provincial mining ministry
description: Manitoba Business, Mining, Trade and Job Creation and its units: Mines Branch, Critical Minerals Office, Manitoba Geological Survey.

name: Provincial environmental assessment
description: The Environment Act licensing process and the Clean Environment Commission.

name: Cabinet, consultation & Crown–Indigenous bodies
description: Political direction, the Crown's consultation function, and new shared-governance bodies.

name: Federal government
description: Federal assessment, critical-minerals policy and the tax rules behind flow-through shares.

name: Courts & tribunals
description: Bodies that settle disputes and define the content of the duty to consult.

name: First Nations
description: Rights-holding Nations named in Manitoba mining files. This is a sample tied to current projects; Manitoba has 63 First Nations.

name: Métis government
description: The Manitoba Métis Federation, government of the Red River Métis.

name: Political organizations
description: Province-wide and regional organizations of First Nations.

name: Indigenous-owned enterprises
description: Companies owned by Nations that develop or hold projects.

name: Majors & producers
description: Companies operating mines in Manitoba, or large companies exploring here.

name: Mid-tiers & developers
description: Companies moving a specific project through permitting toward production or restart.

name: Juniors & explorers
description: Exploration companies, mostly listed on the TSX Venture or CSE, funded largely by equity including flow-through shares.

name: Prospectors
description: Individuals who hold prospecting licences and stake claims.

name: Industry associations
description: Groups that speak for producers or explorers.

name: Contractors & suppliers
description: Drilling, geophysics and other field services.

name: Capital markets & flow-through
description: Exchanges and the investors who buy exploration equity.

name: Public funds & tax credits
description: Government money and tax expenditures aimed at exploration and development.

name: Private capital & royalties
description: Investment funds and royalty companies.

name: Municipalities
description: Host towns and rural municipalities. Governments in their own right, placed here because their stake is local.

name: Environmental & watchdog groups
description: Organizations that monitor, intervene in hearings and campaign.

name: Residents' & land-defence groups
description: Groups formed around a particular project or place.

name: Labour & business
description: Unions and chambers of commerce.

name: Consultants
description: Firms that prepare assessments and studies or run engagement.

name: Legal
description: Lawyers representing parties in hearings and courts.

name: Research & training
description: Universities and colleges.

name: Buyers & offtakers
description: Companies that buy or have agreed to buy a project's output.

name: Power, rail & ports
description: Infrastructure owners whose decisions a project depends on.
